styles.name: hurricane
styles.description: A spinning cyclone with spiral cloud arms and a red eye tracks along its forecast path

styles.name: tornado
styles.description: A twisting funnel drops from a storm cloud and tears across the ground, scattering debris

styles.name: snow-accumulation
styles.description: Star-shaped snowflakes drift down onto a white drift that rises with progress, burying a wooden fence

styles.name: hailstorm
styles.description: Round ice pellets pelt down from a dark cloud, bounce on impact and pile up white as progress grows

styles.name: rainbow-arc
styles.description: A red-to-violet rainbow arcs from the horizon and sweeps across the sky as progress grows

styles.name: fog-roll-in
styles.description: Dense fog rolls in from the left; the leading edge thickens with a shade-glyph gradient

styles.name: barometer
styles.description: Brass-rimmed pressure dial: a red needle sweeps from the storm cloud to the sun as progress rises

styles.name: wind-sock
styles.description: Red-and-white striped windsock on a pole: it droops in calm air and streams out level as progress rises

styles.name: blizzard-whiteout
styles.description: Wind-driven snow streaks thicken until a cabin and pine trees vanish into whiteout at 100%

styles.name: cumulonimbus
styles.description: A puffy cumulus towers up into an anvil-topped thunderhead, then rain and lightning fall from its base

styles.name: frost-crystals
styles.description: Dendritic frost crystals propagate inward from the edges; branching depth grows with progress

styles.name: thermometer
styles.description: Mercury column rises in a thermometer tube; bulb glows at bottom, tick marks show scale
